newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks dive 2.33 percent at close.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks dive 2.33 percent at close.

text.p: Pakistani stocks dived 2.33 percent on short-selling by Thursday's close, before the Friday-Saturday weekend, dealers said. Shares were likely to open depressed in the next trading session on Sunday.

The Karachi 100-share index closed 32.34 points, or 2.33 percent, lower at 1,353.92, after falling some 40 points in early trade. Losers led gainers 197 to 46. Volume rose to 29 million shares from Wednesday's 20 million.
"The selling was so intense that even after some recovery towards the end, the previous levels were still far away," dealer Ali Raza said.
